pages: Day 132: Village after village. Everyone who only heard of the first victims of corruption. All of them. Saving them all. MORE! He pushes us forwards. No rest, no sleep. Time, how much time is left? Can it be stopped? What am I doing here? I should stop Him! Stopping HIM? You shall obey! But... aren't they innocent...? Innocent? Look at them! The corruption runs deep. Too deep for you to notice. But HE knows!

He took the bones of the cleansed and crafted a staff. I don't understand the powers it holds... bending the will of those who oppose him. Torturing their minds. Deforming their bodies into monstrous abominations. All in the name of protecting this world.
